name: Pro Deal Pipeline Board
description: Production deal pipeline / kanban: virtualised columns of 1k+ cards, stage totals and weighted forecast, WIP limits, rotting-deal flags, owner swimlanes, accessible pointer and keyboard drag and drop with live announcements, and optimistic moves with rollback via TanStack Query.

props.name: stages
props.description: { id, title, probability 0-1, wipLimit?, rotDays? } in order

props.name: owners
props.description: { id, name, avatarUrl? }; one swimlane each when grouped

props.name: deals / defaultDeals
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled deals: { id, title, company, amount, stageId, ownerId, rank, stageEnteredAt, closeDate?, probability? }

props.name: onDealsChange
props.description: Next deals after an optimistic move or a rollback

props.name: onMoveDeal
props.description: Persist a move; reject to roll it back (error toast + announcement)

props.name: onOpenDeal
props.description: Click or Enter on a card

props.name: groupByOwner / defaultGroupByOwner
props.description: Owner swimlanes; dropping in another lane reassigns the owner

props.name: enforceWipLimits
props.description: Reject drops into a stage at its WIP limit (default warns only)

props.name: now
props.description: Override current time for rotting flags

props.name: queryClient
props.description: Share your app's TanStack QueryClient; a private one is created otherwise

props.name: renderCardExtra
props.description: Extra node in each card footer

usage: Keyboard: arrows move focus between cards; Space picks up, arrows move (Shift+Up/Down changes owner lane), Space drops, Escape cancels; Enter opens. Every step is announced in a live region. Drag and drop is implemented in-house (hooks/use-pipeline-dnd.ts).
